info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Public Offering Details API
info.description: The Public Offering Details API allows users to retrieve detailed information about specific public offerings in corporate finance. This endpoint is essential for investors, analysts, and financial institutions looking to access comprehensive data on public securities being issued. It supports use cases such as market analysis, investment decision-making, and compliance reporting. By querying this API, consumers can gain insights into offering terms, pricing, and issuer details.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a public offering by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific public offering identified by its unique ID. Clients can use this data for various analytical and reporting purposes related to corporate finance.
